paragraphs: The petrol Sprinter arrived with the VS30 facelift in 2023, a significant change that added a 2.0-litre turbo petrol option to the range for the first time in the current generation. It uses an M270-family 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-four, producing 188hp and driving the rear wheels only — it's a different unit from the diesel OM654 that replaced the outgoing V6, and sits alongside it in the current Sprinter range.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SPRINTER (PETROL) on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the SPRINTER (PETROL) from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
